evidence.detail: R145 ClientSidebarPanel constructs exactly one rs/gui/L and installs it directly on its JTabbedPane with addChangeListener; no other exact-v308 owner constructs the listener.
stateChanged casts the ChangeEvent source to JTabbedPane, reads getSelectedIndex(), then invokes the live Launcher singleton refresh path; the class owns no unrelated state or second callback.
The parent JTabbedPane is the R145 ClientSidebarPanel surface containing Loadouts, PvP Tracker, GPU (Beta), Item Search and optional Developer Tools tabs, fixing this listener to sidebar tab changes.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 Swing listener role. The selected index is read but not otherwise consumed in this class, so no stronger per-tab action name is asserted.
